description: Models latent structure: internal configuration that is not currently accessible (δ ≤ ω for that sub-structure) but structurally exists and may become accessible if δ increases or ω decreases.

latent_structure.informal: Any sub-structure of S that is not accessible to observer O at their current detection capacity.
latent_structure.formal: S_latent(S, O) = { s_i ∈ sub(S) : ω(s_i) ≥ δ(O) }
latent_structure.key_note: Latent structure is NOT absent structure. It exists within S. Its inaccessibility is observation-relative, not a structural property of S itself.

accessible_structure.formal: S_access(S, O) = { s_i ∈ sub(S) : ω(s_i) < δ(O) }
accessible_structure.key_note: S_access and S_latent partition sub(S). Their union equals the complete sub-structure set.

partition_identity.formal: S_access(S,O) ∪ S_latent(S,O) = sub(S)  and  S_access(S,O) ∩ S_latent(S,O) = ∅

partial_revelation_mechanics.description: When sub-structures of S carry heterogeneous opacity values, partial revelation is the typical state: some s_i are revealed, others remain latent. This is the generic case; full revelation and full opacity are the edge cases.
evaluation_sequence: Step 1: Enumerate sub(S) = { s_1, s_2, ..., s_n }
Step 2: Assign ω(s_i) for each s_i via OR-Ω
Step 4: For each s_i, evaluate: reveal(s_i) ⟺ ω(s_i) < δ(O)
Step 6: If |S_access| > 0 and |S_latent| > 0, state is partial revelation
Step 7: Forward results to OR-Π (PartialIndex) for revelation_map construction

full_revelation.description: All sub-structures revealed; δ exceeds every ω(s_i)

full_opacity.description: No sub-structures revealed; δ does not exceed any ω(s_i)

latent_accessibility_pathways.mechanism: Observer improves detection capacity through better methodology, tools, access, or contextual resources.
latent_accessibility_pathways.constraint: δ is bounded by [0,1]. Some ω values may be unreachable regardless of observer capability.
latent_accessibility_pathways.example: Applying additional Book 3 SD operators raises effective δ, revealing previously latent sub-structures.

latent_accessibility_pathways.mechanism: The structure undergoes a configuration change that reduces concealment — a structural transformation.
latent_accessibility_pathways.constraint: ω change requires a genuine reconfiguration of S. Observer action cannot directly alter ω (INV-OR-003).
latent_accessibility_pathways.example: A governance structure (Book 6) forces opacity reduction by mandating disclosure, lowering ω(S).

latent_accessibility_pathways.mechanism: Latent structure is partially characterized through its observable effects on accessible sub-structures.
latent_accessibility_pathways.constraint: Shadow inference produces probabilistic characterizations, not confirmed revelation. Treat outputs as hypotheses.
latent_accessibility_pathways.book3_binding: Uses SD-Σd and SD-Γ operators with OR-context opacity adjustment.

structural_shadow.definition: Observable effects — accessible to the observer — produced by latent sub-structures acting through or upon accessible sub-structures.
structural_shadow.formal: shadow(s_latent) ⊆ S_access — the set of observable signatures of s_latent detectable within S_access
structural_shadow.significance: Structural shadows are the only window into latent structure without direct revelation. They support constrained inference about hidden configuration.

shadow_types.label: Constraint Shadow
shadow_types.description: Accessible sub-structures exhibit constraint patterns that can only be explained by a latent constraining structure.

shadow_types.label: Relational Shadow
shadow_types.description: Accessible sub-structures maintain relations whose form implies a hidden relational partner.

shadow_types.label: Behavioral Shadow
shadow_types.description: System behavior observable at the accessible layer is inconsistent with S_access alone — excess behavior attributable to S_latent.

structural_shadow.inference_limit: Shadow inference does not constitute revelation. Reveal(s_i) remains false until δ > ω(s_i) is directly confirmed.

preconditions: revelation_state from OR-Ρ has been determined
ω(s_i) has been assigned for all s_i ∈ sub(S)
outputs: shadow_set: detected structural shadows within S_access (may be empty)
accessibility_pathways: applicable pathways from latent_accessibility_pathways above
or_lambda_procedure.post_condition: Forward S_latent, S_access, and shadow_set to OR-Π (PartialIndex)
